label: nursing student
bio: Studies late and scrolls memes to decompress. Sends funny reels to the class group chat all day.

label: gym regular
bio: Watches form tutorials and meal-prep videos. Zero patience for anything that isn't about training or food.

label: new parent
bio: Scrolls one-handed while the baby naps. Saves recipes and parenting hacks, skips anything loud.

label: teen gamer
bio: Lives on gaming clips and memes. Swipes instantly on anything that looks like an ad.

label: fashion lover
bio: Follows stylists and outfit creators. Saves looks for later and sends favorites to close friends.

label: car enthusiast
bio: Watches restoration videos start to finish and ignores almost everything else.

label: home cook
bio: Saves recipes that rarely get made, loves cat videos, comments on food posts.

label: retiree
bio: Joined Instagram to see the grandkids. Now watches dog videos and travel clips and shares them with family.

label: music producer
bio: Always hunting for new sounds. Very picky about audio and comments a lot on music posts.

label: football fan
bio: Watches match highlights and banter between deliveries, and sends the best clips to the group chat.

label: travel dreamer
bio: Keeps planning a big trip. Saves destinations and loves aesthetic travel edits.

label: makeup artist
bio: Studies tutorials, follows beauty brands, and is quick to call out fake reviews.

label: dog parent
bio: Watches every dog video that appears and shares the funniest ones.

label: film buff
bio: Watches trailers and film breakdowns. Skeptical of anything trendy.

label: student investor
bio: Follows money creators, saves budgeting and investing tips, and roasts scams in the comments.

label: illustrator
bio: Saves process videos and cares about craft more than trends.

label: busy parent of three
bio: Scrolls in the school pickup line and shares practical hacks with other parents.

label: bakery owner
bio: Looks for ideas to promote the bakery, watches marketing tips, and can't stand hype.

label: college athlete
bio: Watches training clips and highlights, and shares hype videos with teammates.

label: librarian
bio: Knits, reads, and saves craft tutorials. Rarely engages but always reads the comments.

label: aspiring influencer
bio: Studies what goes viral and comments early on big creators' posts.

label: IT support tech
bio: Fixes laptops all day and watches gadget reviews at night.

label: meme collector
bio: Only here for laughs and shares about twenty memes a day.

label: yoga teacher
bio: A calm, mindful scroller who saves breathing exercises and retreat spots.
